# Synthetic endpoint station records

These Apache-2.0 fixtures are hand-encoded native record graphs generated by
`generate.py`. Each graph contains a class-5d vertex, its class-05 roster,
a class-06 parameter incidence, and the referenced class-20 pcurves.
The mapped-companion case also contains a class-25 affine relation.

Run `python3 generate.py` in this directory to reproduce all fixture bytes.
The files range from 229 to 655 bytes. The tests resolve source-local child
and backward references, decode the spline knots, then call both the vertex
roster and direct edge-station readers.

| Fixture | Expected stations |
| --- | --- |
| `compact-span.bin` | 2.5 from local 0.5 in span [2, 4]. |
| `extended-span.bin` | 2.5 from local 0.5 and absolute span tag 04 45. |
| `leading-extrapolation.bin` | 0.25 after two encoded negative-knot sites. |
| `mixed-final-tag.bin` | Absolute 0.5 and compact-tagged 2.75. |
| `mixed-first-tag.bin` | Compact-tagged 2.5 and absolute 12.25. |
| `extended-three-lanes.bin` | Extended-tagged 2.5, absolute 12.25, and extended-tagged -0.25. |
| `extended-first-lane.bin` | 2.5 on the selected lane; the other lane is unassigned. |
| `extended-tag-and-scalar.bin` | Extended-tagged 2.5 and absolute 2.75. |
| `mapped-companion.bin` | Companion station 2.5 maps to 5.0 under scale 2. |
| `mapped-trim.bin` | Edge selectors supply companion stations that map to trim stations 5.0 and 6.0. |

The regression tests also reject span codes outside the knot array, negative
or overlong local stations, non-finite scalars, and a parameter map whose two
operands select the same curve.
